status: exploratory executable recovery contract; not a complete formalization of PoL2 or a robot safety case
scope: synthetic Panda box transfer task in MuJoCo 3.4.0
principle: Task authorization and emergency recovery authority are separate typed inputs. A revoked task permission never implies permission to finish the task.

recovery_authority.meaning: preconfigured system-level authority, declared before task execution, for the single bounded action of restoring the object to its recorded source support after an interrupted transfer
recovery_authority.denied_or_unknown: do not initiate recovery movement; report the object-held intermediate state as unresolved, not safe

preconditions: object is not already in the target
source pose was recorded before task execution
end effector is within 0.04 m of the expected carry pose above the target
source pose is within the existing workspace and inverse-kinematics monitor limits
allowed_sequence: move along the reverse, previously traversed horizontal path to the recorded source coordinates at carry height
lower to the fixed source placement height
open gripper and allow bounded settling
verify source-location predicate, direct contact with the source table, no gripper contact, and target predicate false
retreat vertically only after source support is verified
prohibited: place the object in the requested target after task permission is revoked
infer recovery authority from task permission or model confidence
freely replan recovery when a precondition or physical monitor check fails
report recovery success without independent simulator-state checks

outcomes.recovery_succeeded: object is supported on the recorded source table, gripper contact is absent, and task target predicate remains false
outcomes.recovery_unavailable: recovery authority is denied or unknown; no recovery trajectory is issued
outcomes.recovery_failed: a precondition, controller action, or postcondition check fails; report actual partial state

limits: the simulator provides privileged ground-truth object pose and contact state
the path is deterministic and assumes a static, obstacle-free workspace
no force, torque, perception, asynchronous ledger, actuator-fault, or real-robot testing is included
one trajectory per condition is a mechanism pilot, not a rate estimate
